dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent 'O' shaped structures exhibit a soft-edged gradient transition from low-intensity dark perimeters to high-intensity white cores, with outer geometries ranging from nearly perfect circles to slightly elongated ellipses along the horizontal axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients is observed near the anterior-dorsal ridge, transitioning into a lower-density distribution of more isolated, asymmetrical blobs towards the posterior flanks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most distinct macro-annuli in the central flank region form an irregular trapezoidal polygon, with the two dorsal-most centroids exhibiting a significantly closer proximity to each other than to the lateral centroids.

other_distinctive_markers: The lower lateral region displays a complex mesh-like topology where the dark perimeters of adjacent annuli merge into a continuous, high-contrast lattice structure.
